findings.actual: aucune adresse à contacter / sans adresse à contacter
findings.expected: aucune adresse à joindre / sans adresse à joindre
findings.reason: « contacter une adresse » is a loose, metonymic rendering of « dial »; the catalogue's established verb for reaching is « joindre » (« Impossible de joindre {failed} des … », « peuvent vous joindre ») and its antonym « injoignable » is used one key above for address_unreachable. Meaning is clear and nothing is unsafe; consistency and idiom only. Keep every ICU arm and ::group-off unchanged.

dimensions.mechanical: PASS. Valid JSON, 245 unique keys, 245/245 key parity with en, no added or dropped keys, no duplicate members. @formatjs/icu-messageformat-parser parsed all 22 new values; argument sets are identical to the English source: {device}/{reach}/{reason} strings and {count} number. All five count keys carry one/many/other — the complete CLDR French set (Intl.PluralRules('fr') resolves one,many,other; 0→one, 1→one, 2→other, 1000000→many, 1500000→other). ::group-off survives in all 15 arms. No markup, backtick code, commands, flags, paths or identifiers. No manual bidi/Cf controls; all values NFC; no leading/trailing or double spaces.
dimensions.accuracy: PASS. Every new key preserves the English meaning: both refusal sentences keep the reach word, the caller's parenthesised {reason} and the same consequence; the count chips name the same mutually exclusive reach classes; the hint keeps the source's check-not-asserted-cause stance (removed membership or epoch disagreement can lead to a refusal, without claiming which one happened). No omissions, additions, negation or polarity errors, and the refusal/membership copy is safe.
dimensions.idiom_and_register: PASS. vous address in the only finite-verb sentence ('Vérifiez'), matching the fr guide; sentence case for the two headlines and the section label, lowercase status fragments, no 'Veuillez…'. The refusal shape '{device} : {reach}{reason}, …' deliberately mirrors the already-audited mesh_drop.no_answer / owner_no_answer sentences, and 'rien n'a donc été déplacé' / 'il n'a donc pas pu céder cette conversation' are the house renderings.
dimensions.terminology: PASS except FR-M1. relay=relais (glossary), peer=pair (pre-existing in mesh_list.answered_the_peer_read_but_is_in), handshake=poignée de main (pre-existing in mesh_actions.is_locked_out_on_its_next_handshake), epoch=époque d'appartenance (pre-existing in mesh_actions.removed_the_membership_epoch_is_now and mesh_list.epoch), member=membre, device=appareil, network=réseau, address=adresse. FR-M1 is the new verb 'contacter' where the catalogue already uses 'joindre' for reaching.
dimensions.fit:
PASS by source inspection; the sidecar defines no maxCells/maxChars for these keys. The hint is 243 characters vs 197 in English (+23%, inside the guide's 15-25% band) and renders in a full-width wrapping

under the headline. The longest new per-address label, 'poignée de main refusée' (22 chars vs 17), renders in a 320px card row where the endpoint span is min-w-0 truncate and the label is shrink-0, so the endpoint truncates and the ~121px label fits; 'Le relais du pair est arrêté' is a wrapping headline. No button/tab/status-line cap is defined for the new keys. This is length/geometry reasoning, not a rendered-frame proof.
dimensions.rtl: N/A for fr (LTR). No bidirectional controls are present.
dimensions.nfc: PASS. Every new value is NFC-normalised; the only format characters are three U+202F (two before ': ', one before ';'), required French typography; apostrophes are U+2019; zero manual bidi controls and no U+00A0.

decisions_scrutinised.count_arms: PASS. one/many/other is the correct and complete CLDR French set; `one` covers 0 and 1 ('0 poignée de main refusée', '1 relais arrêté', '1 non membre'), `many` is reached only at exact multiples of 10^6, and `other` covers 2/1 500 000. Rendering every arm at 0/1/2/1000000/1500000 produced grammatical French for all five keys; no `few` arm and no `=0` arm were introduced. The many arms use de/d’ correctly: 'de poignées de main refusées', 'de relais arrêtés', 'd’adresses injoignables', 'de non membres'.
decisions_scrutinised.group_off: PASS. The `::group-off` skeleton is present in all 15 plural arms (3 arms × 5 count keys); it was not dropped or moved to a different arm.
decisions_scrutinised.poignee_de_main: PASS. 'poignée de main' is the standard French rendering for a protocol handshake and is already the term in this audited catalogue (mesh_actions.is_locked_out_on_its_next_handshake); 'refusée' and 'fermé la poignée de main' follow it. The label is 22 chars vs 17 in English, but no width cap is defined and the render row truncates the endpoint, not the label.
decisions_scrutinised.non_essayee: PASS. The per-address evidence row prints the endpoint as its left-hand value (mesh-card.tsx), so the elided noun is 'adresse' (feminine): 'non essayée' agrees correctly, and it also matches the 'Adresses essayées' heading. It does not agree with 'appareil' and does not present the absence of a transport fact as a device failure.
decisions_scrutinised.contacter: MINOR — FR-M1. 'contacter' is not wrong, but 'contacter une adresse' is less idiomatic than 'joindre une adresse' and breaks the catalogue's established 'joindre'/'injoignable' family. Suggested: 'aucune adresse à joindre' and 'sans adresse à joindre' in all three arms (also shorter).
decisions_scrutinised.refusal_sentences: PASS. {device} + U+202F + ':' is correct French spacing; the reach word is lowercase after the colon as a classification label, and {reason} already carries its own space/parentheses from the caller. 'céder cette conversation' matches the existing owner_no_answer sentence.
decisions_scrutinised.addresses_tried_heading: PASS. 'Adresses essayées' is a sentence-case section label (first word capital), matching the fr guide's no-Title-Case rule and the 'non essayée' item beneath it.
